request:
"Implement Admin User Listing (CU-AUTH-06 / HU-17) at GET /api/identity/users. Load and apply `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` and follow constitution rules:
1. Domain (`internal/domain`, stdlib only): validate filter values (`role` against valid `Role` enum, `cefrLevel` if provided) and pagination bounds (`page >= 1` default `1`, `limit` between `1` and `100` default `20`), returning a validation error on invalid filter/pagination parameters.
2. Database (`db/queries/users.sql` + `sqlc generate`): add paginated user listing and total-count queries against the existing `users` table (`id`, `email`, `display_name`, `role`, `cefr_level`, `created_at` â€” never selecting `password_hash`), supporting optional filters by `role`, `cefr_level`, and case-insensitive substring match (`q`) on `email` or `display_name`, ordered by `created_at DESC, id ASC`.
3. SQLite Adapter (`internal/adapter/sqlite/`): implement `ListUsers(ctx, ListUsersFilter) (UserPage, error)` wrapping the `sqlc` queries.
4. Use Case (`internal/usecase/list_users.go`): implement `ListUsersUseCase.Execute(ctx, ListUsersQuery{Role, CEFRLevel, Search, Page, Limit}) (UserPageResult, error)` normalizing defaults and delegating to the consumer-defined `UserLister` repository interface.
5. HTTP, OpenAPI & Wiring (`internal/adapter/http/`, `cmd/api/main.go`):
   - Register `GET /api/identity/users` inside a `chi` route group guarded by `Authenticate` and `RequireRole(\"ADMIN\")`.
   - Parse query params (`role`, `cefrLevel`, `q`, `page`, `limit`) and return `200 OK` with `{\"items\": [{\"id\", \"email\", \"displayName\", \"role\", \"cefrLevel\", \"createdAt\"}], \"total\": N, \"page\": P, \"limit\": L}`.
   - Return `401` when unauthenticated, `403` (`FORBIDDEN`) when caller is not `ADMIN`, and `400`/`422` on invalid query parameters via `respondError`.
   - Update `contracts/identity.openapi.yaml` and `shared/contracts/identity.openapi.yaml`; wire `ListUsersUseCase` in `cmd/api/main.go`.
6. Tests (stdlib `testing`): add unit tests for `ListUsersUseCase`, `:memory:` SQLite integration tests (pagination, role/CEFR/search filters, empty results), and `httptest` handler tests covering `200`, `400`/`422`, `401`, and `403`."
expectations: the list is read-only; editing or deleting accounts is out of scope
no separate admin permission system; role ADMIN on the token is the check
context: area: internal/adapter/http (middleware.go Authenticate and RequireRole already exist; respond_error.go)
constraint: ParseRole returns ErrUnknownRole for unknown roles; CEFRLevel is free text

FR-001.title: Return a page of user summaries with no password

FR-002.title: Newest first with a deterministic tie-break for stable paging

FR-003.title: Report the filtered total independent of the page

FR-004.title: Filter by role, learning level, and case-insensitive text

FR-005.title: Default page 1 limit 20; limit 1 to 100; refuse others

FR-006.title: Refuse an unknown role or learning level

intent: Add GET /api/identity/users for administrators with pagination, role and level filters, and case-insensitive search.

decisions.decision: Each filter is a nullable SQL parameter with (? IS NULL OR column = ?) in both the page and count queries.
decisions.why: The two queries share one predicate, so the page and the total cannot disagree.
decisions.rejected: Dynamically built WHERE clauses in Go

decisions.decision: Search lowercases both the term and the columns and uses LIKE.
decisions.why: SQLite LIKE is case-insensitive only for ASCII by default; lowercasing both sides makes the behaviour explicit.

decisions.decision: Order by created_at DESC, id ASC.
decisions.why: Two accounts created in the same instant would otherwise page unstably.

decisions.decision: Pagination and filter rules live in the domain, not the handler.
decisions.why: They are business rules and a non-HTTP caller must get the same guarantees.

decisions.decision: Roles are validated against ParseRole; learning levels are matched as stored text.
decisions.why: Registration never constrained the level, so validating against a scale would refuse legitimate data.
decisions.rejected: Validate levels against the CEFR scale

plan.summary: Plan: shared WHERE predicate for page and count, lowercased search, stable ordering, domain-owned validation.
plan.key_finding: Authenticate and RequireRole already exist, so the admin gate is a route decoration rather than new middleware.

tasks.summary: 16 tasks: Setup, Foundational storage and validation, US1 list, US2 filters, US3 paging, US4 admin gate, US5 parameter refusal, Polish.

approach: Add a UserLister port over a paginated list and count query pair sharing one predicate, domain validation of filters and bounds, a use case that normalizes defaults, and an admin-guarded handler.

sqlc rewrites a repeated sqlc.narg into positional ?1..?3 only when a later named arg forces numbering; LIMIT/OFFSET therefore use sqlc.arg so the filter params stay correctly bound. A change to this query must re-check the generated argument order.
